summary_ja: SGI-Benchの2026年gated datasetによるWeb検索汚染対策と、AstaBenchの2,400超・11 benchmark、git SHA、toolset、sandbox、model usage cost、harness資源条件を追加しました。科学agentの整備容量をmodel GPUだけで見ず、holdout管理、CPU・memory・storage、tool、judge、retryを含む評価contractとして扱います。単一モデルによる暫定調査で、Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: This update adds SGI-Bench's 2026 gated-dataset control against web-search contamination and AstaBench's 2,400-plus examples across 11 benchmarks, git SHA, toolsets, sandboxes, model-usage cost, and harness resource conditions. Scientific-agent capacity is treated as an evaluation contract covering holdouts, CPU, memory, storage, tools, judges, and retries rather than model GPUs alone. This is provisional single-model research with Consensus incomplete.

sections.title_ja: 科学agent benchmarkの汚染・tool・費用・実行資源contract
sections.title_en: Contamination, tools, cost, and execution-resource contracts for scientific-agent benchmarks
sections.summary_ja: SGI-BenchとAstaBenchを、scoreではなく汚染防止、task範囲、tool境界、cost logging、実行資源で比較します。
sections.summary_en: Compare SGI-Bench and AstaBench by contamination control, task scope, tool boundaries, cost logging, and execution resources rather than headline scores.

items.name_ja: SGI-BenchはWeb検索による問題漏洩を抑えるためdatasetをgated化
items.name_en: SGI-Bench gates datasets to reduce question leakage through web search
items.statement_ja: SGI-Benchは10分野・1,000超のexpert-curated sampleを、deliberation、conception、action、perceptionの研究cycleで評価します。2026年6月に、評価agentがWeb検索で問題を直接発見することを抑えるためHugging Face datasetをgated化し、連絡先共有への同意とread-only tokenを必要としました。自動承認gateは検索露出を減らしますが、既学習modelへの混入、参加者間共有、出力漏洩を完全には防ぎません。
items.statement_en: SGI-Bench evaluates more than 1,000 expert-curated samples across ten disciplines and the scientific cycle of deliberation, conception, action, and perception. In June 2026 it gated Hugging Face datasets to reduce direct discovery of questions by evaluated agents through web search, requiring agreement to share contact information and a read-only token. Automatic gating reduces search exposure but cannot fully prevent pretraining contamination, participant sharing, or output leakage.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: OpenFSのAI評価でも、公開調査能力とholdout評価を分け、task access、token権限、実行log、結果公開範囲を管理する必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: OpenFS evaluation should separate public-web research capability from held-out evaluation and govern task access, token authority, run logs, and result disclosure.
adoption_conditions_ja: 公開・gated・blind testを分け、modelのdata cutoffと既知問題を申告する。
dataset tokenをread-only・期限付きにし、agent環境からsecretを隔離する。
task・answer・trajectoryの公開範囲と漏洩時の版更新を定義する。
adoption_conditions_en: Separate public, gated, and blind tests and declare model data cutoffs and known exposure.
Use read-only, expiring dataset tokens isolated from the agent environment.
Define disclosure of tasks, answers, and trajectories and version changes after leakage.

items.name_ja: AstaBenchはtool・git・sandbox・model利用量を評価contractに含む
items.name_en: AstaBench includes tools, git state, sandboxes, and model usage in its evaluation contract
items.timing_ja: ICLR 2026採択版、repository v0.3.1手順を確認
items.timing_en: ICLR 2026 version; repository instructions for v0.3.1 reviewed
items.statement_ja: AstaBenchは11 benchmark・2,400超の例を、文献検索、code実行、data解析、end-to-end discoveryにまたがって提供します。実行時にgit SHAをlogし、既定では未commit変更があると失敗させ、task固有tool、Docker sandbox、toolset・openness分類、model usageのcost loggingを扱います。full suiteはframeworkだけで最大約10 GB、一部code taskは20～30 GBを使い、内部実験は128 GB・8物理coreで8並列、少ないmemoryではOOMが起きたとしています。これはmodel推論GPUを含む総資源ではなく、harness側の公表経験値です。
items.statement_en: AstaBench provides more than 2,400 examples across 11 benchmarks spanning literature search, code execution, data analysis, and end-to-end discovery. Runs record the git SHA and fail by default on uncommitted changes, while the framework tracks task-specific tools, Docker sandboxes, toolset and openness classifications, and model-usage cost. The full suite may use about 10 GB internally; some coding tasks use 20-30 GB, and internal experiments used 128 GB and eight physical cores for eight parallel problems, with lower memory causing OOM failures. These are reported harness-side requirements, not total resources including model-inference GPUs.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 科学agent評価の容量計画ではmodel GPUだけでなく、sandbox memory・CPU・storage、tool API、judge、log、並列度、retryを別々に積算できます。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Scientific-agent capacity planning can separately account for sandbox memory, CPU, storage, tool APIs, judges, logs, parallelism, and retries in addition to model GPUs.
adoption_conditions_ja: benchmark・git・container・tool・model・judge・price snapshotをrunごとに固定する。
model usage外のCPU、memory、storage、network、sandbox起動、retry費用を計測する。
toolset・openness・外部service差をscoreと同じ表で公開する。
adoption_conditions_en: Pin benchmark, git, container, tools, models, judges, and price snapshots for each run.
Measure CPU, memory, storage, network, sandbox startup, and retry cost outside model usage.
Publish toolset, openness, and external-service differences alongside scores.
